product_one_liner.value: Plannerly helps building owners, architects, engineers and contractors collaboratively plan BIM requirements, assign and track deliverables, and verify models against ISO 19650 workflows.

founded_year.notes: The company profile and contemporary reporting give 2017; some funding databases instead give 2015.

eng_blog.notes: The blog covers BIM management, ISO 19650 and industry workflows, rather than engineering accounts of how Plannerly is built.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No public Plannerly careers page, job board or qualifying live posting was located; absence of a jobs board does not establish a negative answer.

model_provider.notes: Named in the provider list for optional AI features; no specific underlying model version is disclosed there.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page attributes ISO 27001 certifications and SOC 2 reports to infrastructure providers; Plannerly says its own certification is being prepared, not completed.

last_funding.notes: CB Insights dates the latest accelerator round to March 29, 2019, matching the accelerator announcement; Caplight dates it April 3, 2019. Amount is not publicly disclosed in these sources. An uncorroborated directory claim of an April 2025 Series A conflicts with these funding records and is not treated as verified.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round in the funding records is the 2019 accelerator round, before May 9, 2025; no later dated funding announcement was verified.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No public Plannerly careers page, job board or qualifying live posting was located; absence of a jobs board does not establish a negative answer.

launched_6mo.notes: A major platform release was announced August 11, 2026, followed by the mobile launch September 5, 2026, both within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Louie Moran's profile dates his VP, Customer Success role at Plannerly from August 2017 to January 2026, establishing a VP departure within the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Boundo identifies Plannerly as a customer and carries a CEO testimonial about email outreach; the Plannerly page embeds an Intercom widget. Neither establishes use of any particular CRM integrated with Boundo.
